contract.om4_averaged_readout: equal-weight six native five-day forecast bins (30 days)

velocity_init_signed_crps.scope: OM4 latest initializer state only; all uo/vo depths
velocity_init_signed_crps.estimator: fair CRPS of signed spatial increments
velocity_init_signed_crps.path_mask: all traversed cells wet and target-finite; periodic longitude, bounded latitude
velocity_init_signed_crps.aggregation: endpoint-mean area weights; equal supported channels, directions and lags

contract.initial_reconstruction: latest state, available surface for OBS; all fields for OM4
contract.monthly_readout: calendar-weighted member trajectories, not direct denoising
contract.native_readout: all native leads averaged, not random single-lead subsampling
contract.normalization: fixed OM4 grid mean/std, frozen OBS ERA5 statistics

interpretation: Paired conditioning interventions, one training seed; donor fields may be out of distribution. No causal ocean claim.
interior_swap: Independent donor-year initialization uses donor surface/validity, donor ERA5 and actual donor-date calendar with paired noise. Both interior history states replaced; both recipient generated SST/SSH states retained. All future ERA5/calendar stay recipient.
full_state_swap: Both complete initial history states from the independent donor-year initialization; all future forcing/calendar stay recipient.
metrics: Cos-latitude common reference/climatology support. RMSE of ensemble mean; fair finite-ensemble CRPS. Monthly OM4 climatology from unique training frames; OBS climatology from unique training dates. Missing/zero-variance scores are null.
